model_and_sampling: Same pinned initial checkpoint, prompts, FP32 master/BF16 autocast, T=.7, top_k=50, top_p=1, output cap1024; fresh seed10004; two sequential batches of12. Any A10080 variant is allowed for new draws; actual device recorded.
selection: First candidate in draw order with a numerically correct answer, nonempty reasoning, and a semantically sound full pre-answer trace. Review candidate0 first; use candidate1 only if candidate0 fails. Retain all attempts. Any additional bounded redraw requires an appended policy record.
criterion: Read original problem and entire pre-answer reasoning; flag explicit incorrect quantities, equations, relations or contradictory mathematical claims, including subsequently corrected ones. Mere uncertainty without an incorrect asserted relation is not rejected. One ambiguous bound claim is conservatively redrawn. Token-boundary fragments are interpreted in the full original trace, not as complete equations.
preserved: All100 questions, original K4 filter evidence and IDs/order, four alpha locations; retain original cache and API responses unchanged. No clean-trace hand edits.
paper_alignment: Extra semantic trace acceptance is a reconstruction choice to enforce the sound clean-window assumption in section3.2. It is not a stated author filter and does not alter online training rewards or trace selection.
outcome_independence: No baseline or trained model outcomes have been generated or inspected; never select on recoverability.
api_reuse: Reuse only responses with exactly identical context ID and request payload; preserve source response hash and original location.
